label: Women's T20I
methodology: Replay 100 completed first innings. At each checkpoint, predict final score from match state without future data. Fielding ratings from Cricsheet ball-by-ball data (5094 players, 110 teams).
summary: Across 500 predictions the model has an MAE of 15.0 runs and RMSE of 19.8 runs. Bias is -2.2 runs (the model undershoots on average). The predicted range captures the actual score 58.6% of the time with an average range width of 30 runs. Error by final score bucket: low-scoring (<160): 13.5 runs MAE, mid-range (160–200): 21.1 runs MAE, high-scoring (200+): 18.8 runs MAE. Predictions are least accurate at the 6-over checkpoint (MAE 20.5 runs) and most accurate at 16 overs (MAE 10.0 runs).
